title: Extract core LoRa peripheral models (SX1262, SX127x, LR1110) - decouple from LICHEN-specific interfaces
description:
Expand peripheral coverage beyond SX126x:
- SX1262 (already done in ddcu)
- SX127x series (SX1276/77/78/79) - new peripheral needed
- LR1110 - new peripheral needed

All peripherals should have generic APIs decoupled from LICHEN-specific interfaces.
